# Offcut labels

Print or write these before cutting and keep them with the samples. L and R are the WEARER's
left and right, which is the convention the region map and the app both use. Write the
convention on the label itself: the person reading it in three weeks will not remember.

```
  +------------------------------------------+
  |  <GARMENT_ID>_OFFCUT_L                   |
  |  wearer's LEFT leg                       |
  |  cut on ______________  by ____________  |
  |  wash condition: ______________________  |
  |  mass before ______ g   after ______ g   |
  +------------------------------------------+

  +------------------------------------------+
  |  <GARMENT_ID>_OFFCUT_R                   |
  |  wearer's RIGHT leg                      |
  |  cut on ______________  by ____________  |
  |  wash condition: ______________________  |
  |  mass before ______ g   after ______ g   |
  +------------------------------------------+
```

The assignment alternates across garments: one offcut follows the standard protocol in the
same load as the garment, the other is washed in a separate standard load. Which leg gets
which swaps from garment to garment so the leg and the condition are not confounded.
`tools/pilot.py offcut` records it.
